description: List a contact's in-app messages and content cards (created by type "in_app" sequence steps). status "open" (default) is what their app should show now; "all" is history. Identify the contact by email, externalId or subscriberId.

actions.description: Open items only: comma-separated button actions the app handles beyond open_url and dismiss, e.g. "request_push_permission". Items with other actions (push primers) are left out unless listed, and stay for an app that handles them.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

externalId.description: Contact external ID from your app.

formats.description: Message formats the caller renders. Open feeds leave other formats out; default modal, banner and fullscreen, so custom HTML messages appear only when "html" is listed. History lists every format and includes the HTML document when "html" is listed.

kind.description: Only messages, cards or placement items. Placement items are listed only with status "all"; for what a placement shows now use get_in_app_placement_content.

name: list_in_app_messages

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_in_app_messages` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

messages.description: List of in-app message records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
